description: Pins the id and size rules, the disk-resize POST body, the new_size_mb echo the size argument fills through its alias, and the preview that reads the disk being resized.

cases.name: rejects missing linode_id
cases.expect_error: linode_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects missing disk_id
cases.expect_error: disk_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a size below one
cases.expect_error: size is required and must be greater than 0

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This resizes the disk. The instance must be powered off. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: Disk resizes from 1024 MB to 2048 MB.
warnings: The instance must be powered off to resize a disk.
